# The New Black AI

> The New Black is an all-in-one AI fashion platform that lets brands and designers create clothing designs, generate AI fashion models, run virtual try-ons, produce tech packs, and build entire campaigns — without photoshoots, sampling cycles, or fragmented tools.

Trusted by 500,000+ fashion creators and brands across 150+ countries, The New Black unifies the full production cycle from concept to e-commerce. The platform is organized into seven dedicated AI studios, supports custom Brand DNA training for consistent on-brand output, offers team collaboration, and exposes every feature through a developer API.

## AI Studios

- [AI Fashion Design](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-clothing-fashion-design-generator): Create, transform, and animate clothing designs from text or reference images, including sketch-to-design, fabric-to-design, ghost mannequin, color and fabric swapping, 3D garments, and AI fashion videos.
- [AI Fashion Models](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-generated-models): Turn product images into realistic on-model imagery for clothing, jewelry, bags, shoes, swimwear, and accessories; supports consistent model identity across catalogs.
- [AI Virtual Try-On](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-virtual-try-on-clothes): Place clothing, jewelry, bags, shoes, or accessories on any model image with realistic proportions, lighting, and perspective.
- [AI Tech Pack Generator](https://thenewblack.ai/clothing-fashion-techpack): Auto-fill factory-ready tech packs with AI-generated flat sketches, size charts, grading, and bills of materials; export to PDF.
- [AI Stylist](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-outfit-generator-coach-assistant-stylist): Personal AI outfit generator with color analysis, outfit-on-self visualization, and outfit-to-shopping flows.
- [AI Branding](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-logo-ai-moodboard-generator-for-brands): Generate brand logos, logo variations, moodboards, store interior concepts, brand names, slogans, and unique selling points.
- [AI Trends](https://thenewblack.ai/fashion_news_trends_forecast): Real-time fashion trend analysis and forecasting from social, retail, and runway data, with image-based trend Q&A.

## Core Features

- [All AI Features](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-design-features): Full index of every AI capability across the seven studios, with tutorials.
- [Brand DNA](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-design-features/ai-clothing-fashion-design-from-reference-images-dataset): Train the AI on reference images to enforce a consistent brand aesthetic across all generations.
- [Bulk Generation](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-design-features/generate-ai-fashion-in-bulk): Process up to 30 product images in a single run to generate AI fashion models or designs for an entire catalog.
- [AI Video Generator](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-design-features/ai-fashion-video-generator): Turn any fashion image or text prompt into a ready-to-use video for e-commerce, campaigns, and social media.
- [HD Upscaling](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-design-features/upscale-photo-in-hd-with-ai): Convert generated visuals into high-definition, campaign-ready imagery.
- [Team Collaboration](https://thenewblack.ai/ai-design-features/collaborative-clothing-fashion-design): Add sub-accounts and work on collections together as a team.

## Developers

- [Fashion API](https://thenewblack.ai/clothing_fashion_api_integrations): REST endpoints for every AI feature — design generation, virtual try-on, fashion models, tech packs, ghost mannequin, fabric-to-design, and more. Credits-based pricing, AWS-hosted, GDPR-compliant.
- [Virtual Try-On API](https://thenewblack.ai/clothing_fashion_api_integrations/virtual-try-on): Combine a model image with up to three product images (clothing, accessory, or jewelry) in a single call.
- [Fashion Model API](https://thenewblack.ai/clothing_fashion_api_integrations/ai-generated-models-api): Generate consistent AI fashion models for products via API.
